text:
tara-people-ops: Quick heads-up — we have a condensed SOC2 evidence handoff this cycle and an ISO mapping request tied to the same artifacts. Please read and follow the checklist below. Office hours tomorrow 10:00am PT in #help for 30m. :clipboard:

sam-engineering: Quick Q — is this one S3 bucket for all teams or per-team prefixes?

tara-people-ops: per-team prefixes. Use the standard prefix format and tag uploads with control IDs. Example path (please copy/paste):

```
s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2026/soc2/<TEAM_NAME>/<artifact>-v1.pdf
```

leo-security: Important: if an artifact contains customer PII, either redact before upload or encrypt with the team's KMS key and add the kms_key tag. Do not put raw PII in the public evidence bucket.

maria-legal: For ISO27001 mapping, add the control mapping metadata in the upload comment: e.g., `iso:A.9.2:access-control`. That helps the audit team run automated mapping.

sam-engineering: Got it. What about screenshots/log snippets that show IPs? redact or mask?

leo-security: Mask IPs unless the log is required for a security incident. If masking prevents verification, flag the artifact as `sensitive:needs-review`.

jamie-ops: Pasting the minimal handoff checklist here so folks can copy it quickly:

```
- Artifact filename: <team>-<control>-<date>.pdf
- S3 path: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2026/soc2/<TEAM_NAME>/
- Control tags: SOC2-CC-5.1, ISO:A.9.2
- Owner: @<owner-handle>
- Redaction: yes/no (if yes, note what was redacted)
- Access: kms_key=<key-id> (only if encrypted)
- Notes: short description + evidence steps
```

tara-people-ops: Timeline: please upload all SOC2 evidence items by EOD Wednesday. ISO mapping docs by Friday COB. If you need an extension, file a quick ticket and tag me — we can triage but prefer to keep the window tight.

sam-engineering: Can we get a small script to automate naming/tags? I'll volunteer to add a tiny CLI for the team.

tara-people-ops: yes please — that would help a lot. If you push a PR, ping me and leo-security for a quick review.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Evidence upload deadline in 48 hours. (sent to owners list)

maria-legal: Note for folks handling contractual evidence: if an artifact references a customer contract, coordinate with Legal before uploading. We prefer a sanitized extract and a secure link rather than the whole contract.

jamie-ops: If anyone wants the checklist as a Google Doc or a one-click folder template, DM me and I'll drop it in your team Drive.

sam-engineering: Uploading three items now (will tag SOC2-CC-5.1, ISO:A.9.2). ETA 30m.

tara-people-ops: Perfect — thanks everyone. If you run into any edge cases (legacy logs, closed incidents), post here or bring them to office hours. We'll keep a decision log so owners can reference past rulings. :sparkles:
